config.articulation_policy: Exact unchanged camera-relative pose and body orientation
config.support_policy: Independent rear departure and lead arrival, overlap allowed; marker confidence and image speed; no hard position anchors
config.camera_policy: Each existing f4 estimated camera held constant to isolate root-only effects; not measured intrinsics
config.floor_policy: One constant plane per candidate, three uncalibrated normal hypotheses; no per-frame floor or floor lift
config.timing: Broadcast timestamps; slow-motion physical time is unknown
